system.description: When you cast this incantation, up to ten nearby creatures experience an emotion of your choice: fear, joy, sorrow, guilt, etc. The effect lasts for up to 10 minutes (1 dungeon action), while the power of the effect depends upon your casting check. With no sparks, the emotion will be no more than a subtle undercurrent. With three or more sparks, you overwhelm the subjects with a rush of emotion.
